title: AuraAthletic Fit:
headline: A short photo video carried by a voice-over: AuraAthletic Fit is a woman-owned WNY business for female athletes, and it is in the What She's Made Of fashion show on Nov 5.
story: Suzanne's direction: We weren't able to get any video of Aura Athletics but here are some pics and a description of the company with their website. Can you do a quick little video of them and just say that they'll be one of our women-owned businesses featured in our fashion show. You won't want to miss What She's Made Of at Highmark Stadium on November 5.

There is no video and no speech, so Suzanne asked for a voice-over to fill the gaps. The voice-over runs start to end over the photos. Every word of it comes from Suzanne's ask or the owner's own description (Rebekah, owner). Nothing is added.
do: Cut the photos to the voice-over: change the photo on the line, not in the middle of a word.
Use the voice-over script on this page word for word.
Give every photo gentle motion (slow push in or pan).
Burn in captions of the voice-over in the purple caption boxes.
Match the Ms Eye Candy cut: ombre open and close, end card with voice-over.
Put @auraathleticfit716 small on the end card.
dont: Do not use the IDA cleat ad (IDA-AW24-TableTent…png) as their logo. It is another brand's ad.
Do not make other brands' names (Fazit, Laki, Everything Hurts, IDA) the focus of a shot.
Do not add lines or claims to the voice-over that are not on this page.

transcript:
VOICE-OVER SCRIPT (V1):
[00:00] Made for her body, her game, and her confidence.
[00:04] AuraAthletic Fit is a woman-owned business right here in Western New York, on a mission to support female athletes.
[00:10] Owner Rebekah was inspired by her daughter, a multisport athlete. She built Aura so girls and women can find gear designed with them in mind.
[00:17] Most of it is made by women, for women. From training, to game day, to everyday life.
[00:22] And AuraAthletic Fit is one of the women-owned businesses featured in our What She's Made Of fashion show.
[00:28] You won't want to miss What She's Made Of, at Highmark Stadium, November 5th.

--- SOURCE ---
No speech in the photos. Owner's description (Rebekah, owner, by email): AuraAthletic Fit is a woman-owned WNY business on a mission to support female athletes with apparel and accessories made for her body, her game, and her confidence, while building a community and empowering women in sports. Inspired by my daughter's experience as a multisport athlete, I created Aura to make it easier for girls and women to find products designed with them in mind. The majority of our products are made By Women For Women. From training to game day and even everyday life, Aura is here to help women look good, feel good, and play great!
